messages.body:
Hi Julie and Ann,

Thank you so much for getting in touch, Jake would love to come and perform at Penton Park.

His prices are all cash on the night:

Two 1 hour sets: £300 for a single night, or £250 a night if you book four dates.
Three sets of 40 or 45 minutes: £350 for a single night, or £300 a night if you book four dates.

His free Saturdays in 2027 are:

2 and 9 January
6 and 27 March
10 April
22 May
5 and 26 June
24 and 31 July
11 September
16 October
6 and 20 November
11 and 18 December

Just let me know which date or dates suit and I'll lock them in for you. The four date deal does tend to book up quickly. You can see and hear more of Jake at www.jakeessex.co.uk

Kind regards,
Natalie
